# parlay-club

> Docs map generated by `good-vibes docs index`. Edit the docs, then regenerate this file.

## Concept

- [Access](concepts/access.md): How Google sign-in, open sign-up, and signed session and group cookies decide who is using the app and which group they see.
- [Analyzer](concepts/analyzer.md): How the sharp-friend banner under a slip turns legs, games, weather, player stats, and nfelo's model into plain-Go warnings, and the tone those warnings keep.
- [Response archive](concepts/archive.md): How every successful external API response is kept raw in SQLite, how the source key labels it, and how to read the stored metadata and gzipped bodies.
- [Data refresh](concepts/data-refresh.md): How page loads and on-demand views drive lazy syncs of the slate, weather, game lines, props, rosters, injuries, game logs, nfelo projections, and auto-grading, with per-source staleness windows, single-flight, failure backoff, tiered Parlay API and The Odds API credit floors, an archive of every successful response, a synchronous sandbox bootstrap, and a shutdown drain that cancels in-flight syncs.
- [Export](concepts/export.md): How a locked slip turns stored sportsbook deep links into a one-tap combined DraftKings or FanDuel link, with per-leg taps, a manual list, and copy text for every pick that has no link.
- [Groups](concepts/groups.md): How groups split people into shared clubs, how invites and leaving work, how recurring slip schedules automate weekly slips, and how the active group scopes what a person sees.
- [Live updates](concepts/live-updates.md): How a slip page hears about changes through one SSE stream, and how the hub, deadlines, and client reconnect keep that stream cheap.
- [Persistence](concepts/persistence.md): How one SQLite file holds every slip and every cached response, how Litestream restores and replicates it on Cloud Run, why only one process may write to it, and how the local sandbox keeps its own file and stage row.
- [Record Book](concepts/record-book.md): How a group's season Record Book aggregates graded slips, chronological win/loss streaks, active-leg Units P/L, member leaderboard rankings, the Parlay Terrorist badge, and personal wager Dollar P/L.
- [Slips](concepts/slips.md): How a group builds shared parlays from the slate, with slate scopes and deadline isolation, multi-slip week views, sibling slip switching, one-off slip creation, the hub's next-step banner and deadline, the game-first pick board and its pick dock, members, legs, votes, wagers, quick-add, create-slip defaults, grading, the editing and locking rules, and research.

## Decision

- [Sharp-friend analyzer](decisions/analyzer.md): Add a deterministic rules engine that reviews the whole slip and shows friendly, non-blocking heads-ups to everyone, including pairings across two people's legs.
- [Deployment readiness and hardening](decisions/deploy-readiness.md): Harden the server lifecycle, startup checks, proxy URL handling, and deploy pipeline in one focused pass before the first production launch.
- [The Odds API fallback and enrichment](decisions/draftkings-links.md): Wrap Parlay API and The Odds API behind a composite odds provider that coordinates enrichment and fallback while keeping the rest of the refresh and export pipeline unchanged.
- [Export locked slips to DraftKings and FanDuel](decisions/export-to-sportsbook.md): Once a slip is fully locked in, the slip page shows an export panel with a button for each sportsbook.
- [Foundation](decisions/foundation.md): Build a bootable web server with a local database, a shared group passcode, and a "who are you?" picker that remembers each friend on their device.
- [Game-first pick board](decisions/game-first-board.md): ```mermaid flowchart LR W[Week: every side of every line] --> C[Chips] C --> R[One flat row list] R --> T[Tray rail or below the list] ``` ```mermaid flowchart LR S[Game slate] -->|choose a game| G[Game detail] G --> P[Category tabs] P --> L[Paired line rows] L --> D[Pick dock: count and odds] ``` Rebuild the pick board as a game-first master-detail screen.
- [Google sign-in](decisions/google-oauth.md): Replace the passcode and the name picker with Google's OpenID Connect sign-in.
- [Groups and solo play](decisions/groups.md): Make the group the boundary for everything people share.
- [History, manual grading, and deploy](decisions/history-and-deploy.md): Deploy to Cloud Run inside the free tier, with the database backed up to Cloud Storage and deploys blocked during game windows.
- [Hot reload local dev](decisions/hot-reload-dev.md): Add [air](https://github.com/air-verse/air) as the dev runner, pinned in `mise.toml` from the mise registry.
- [In-App Bug Reports](decisions/in-app-bug-reports.md): Add a bug report button to the shared app layout so it appears on every screen.
- [Local Sunday Sandbox](decisions/local-sunday-sandbox.md): Add a development-only scenario mode to the existing dev task rather than a separate mock app.
- [Team Logos and Player Portraits](decisions/logos-and-portraits.md): Capture official team logo and player headshot URLs from the existing ESPN scoreboard and roster syncs, store them alongside our game and roster records, and surface them in view models for screens where visual identity aids scanning.
- [nfelo signals in the analyzer](decisions/nfelo-signals.md): Treat nfelo as one more free, lazily synced source, beside ESPN and Open-Meteo.
- [Parlay API for odds and props](decisions/parlay-api.md): Switch the odds client from The Odds API to Parlay API and add bulk per-game prop fetching on the same client.
- [Props and research](decisions/props-research.md): Load player props for a game when someone opens it, within the Odds API budget.
- [Archive every external response](decisions/raw-response-archive.md): Add one append-only archive of raw responses in SQLite, written by a single seam that every outside call passes through.
- [Slate, weather, and lines](decisions/slate-and-lines.md): Pull the Sunday and Monday slate from ESPN, stadium weather from Open-Meteo, and game lines from The Odds API, fetched only when someone opens the app and the data is stale.
- [Live shared slips](decisions/slips-live.md): Add shared slips: each week has one or more slips, each slip has members, and every member adds the same number of legs.
- [Thursday Night Games and Multi-Slip Events](decisions/thursday-and-multi-slips.md): Extend the game slate to ingest Thursday night football games.
- [Make the weekly pick flow the center of the app](decisions/weekly-pick-flow.md): Land on your groups, see what the week needs on the hub, pick on a searchable board, lock in, vote, and export.

## Guide

- [GCP setup](guides/gcp-setup.md): Create the Google Cloud project resources once, add the secrets and GitHub variables, and run the first deploy that puts the app on Cloud Run.
- [Local development](guides/local-dev.md): Start the app with hot reload, run the offline Sunday sandbox, set up the git hooks, and fall back to a plain server run when you need it.

## Reference

- [Analyzer rules](reference/analyzer-rules.md): The stable IDs, severities, triggers, and example messages for the correlation, weather, key-number, chalk, player stats, and nfelo model rules in internal/analyzer.
- [Configuration](reference/config.md): Environment variables the server reads, their dev defaults, the odds provider keys and GitHub issue reporting settings they configure, the offline sandbox switch, and the values it rejects in prod.
- [Data sources](reference/data-sources.md): The free sources behind the slate, the ESPN scoreboard endpoint and its Sunday and Monday filter, the Open-Meteo forecast behind a game's weather, Parlay API game lines and props with The Odds API enrichment and fallback, ESPN rosters, game logs, and summary injuries, player matching, nfelo model projections, bookmakers, deep links, tiered credit floors, and the raw response archive every successful call leaves.
- [History file](reference/history-file.md): The seed/history.yaml format, its slip and leg fields and defaults, how boot imports it into the first group, which slips are skipped, and how errors and users are handled.
- [Odds math](reference/odds-math.md): The formulas in internal/parlay for converting American and decimal odds, combining legs, picking a reference price, and computing payout and units.
- [Routes](reference/routes.md): Every HTTP route the server serves, the middleware in front of them, and the status codes, HTMX headers, and SSE frames handlers return.
- [Sandbox replay](reference/sandbox-replay.md): The fail-closed HTTP transport and named week 9 response registry behind the local Sunday sandbox, the requests they answer or leave as labeled empty fallbacks, which fixtures are real captures versus derived snapshots, and how startup, reset, stages, seeded people, and scripted grades replay them.
- [Database schema](reference/schema.md): SQLite tables, including groups and their members, legs and their votes, odds rows with sportsbook deep links, rosters and player game logs for props research, player name matching, nfelo model projections, the raw external response archive, how migrations are tracked and applied, and connection settings.

## Runbook

- [Archive size check](runbooks/archive-size.md): Measure the raw response archive and the SQLite file, know the number to act at, and prune old responses without losing the parsed tables.
- [Custom domain with Cloudflare](runbooks/custom-domain.md): Route a custom subdomain to Cloud Run through Cloudflare with origin header rewriting and OAuth callback configuration.
- [Deploy](runbooks/deploy.md): How a commit reaches Cloud Run, why deploys pause during game windows, how to force one, and how to verify, roll back, and read the spend.
- [Google OAuth setup](runbooks/google-oauth-setup.md): Create the Google Web client, register the local and prod redirect URIs, publish the consent screen, and set the client secrets.
